context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A rl of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.777 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2026-09-18. CAVEATS: the comparison row is labelled 'R1-Distill-Qwen backbone' rather than by repo id; read as deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, which is what the card's base_model tag and prose name. MATH-500 L1 is N/R for this checkpoint. Pass@3 with k=3 - not Pass@1 - so it is not directly comparable to single-sample AIME numbers elsewhere in the catalog.
